patch_description: The Kalman stage is the only causal (phase-lagging) element in the pipeline; the SG, median snap, and polish are all zero-phase. Prior-gen evidence (the crossover program) shows that fusing the forward capped-Q adaptive Kalman 50/50 with a time-reversed pass reduces slope_changes (23.2 vs 24.2), lag_error (0.42 vs 0.43), and false_reversals (20.4 vs 21.0) while leaving correlation/smoothness unchanged — the backward pass sees turning points with opposite-signed phase error, so averaging cancels interior lag at zero smoothness cost. I add a thin BidirectionalKalmanStage wrapper around the untouched, validated AdaptiveKalmanStage and swap it into the pipeline run(), keeping the graded median snap, recency convolution, hysteresis snap, and polish intact. Short-input guard (n < 4) falls back to the single forward pass, so n = window_size and n = window_size+1 edge cases remain safe.
